---

name: Feature request
about: Propose a new capability or improvement
title: '[Feature] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''

---

**Is your feature request related to a problem?**

A clear and concise description of what the problem is, e.g. "I'm always
frustrated when [...]".

**Describe the solution you'd like**

What should happen, and where (app UI / keyboard / protocol / settings).

**Does it touch security-relevant behavior?**

If yes (crypto, protocol format, key handling, clipboard, permissions),
please outline the security implications; such changes require tests and
documentation per CONTRIBUTING.md before implementation.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**

Including "do nothing" and why it is insufficient.

**Additional context**

Mock-ups, references to other keyboards, protocol drafts, etc.
